Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: CalebK
Message:
qa: audit AUTH-01 runs, emulator/phone split, finding F3

- reports: the three Antigravity runs (phone 1033 and 1113, emulator
  0508), each with an Audit section. 0508 had an undisclosed stray signup
  (emulator typing scrambled "ama" into "maa") and a crash marked PASS.
- findings.md F3: Fabric addViewAt IllegalStateException kills the app
  right after stylist sign-up (emulator); to confirm on the phone.
- DEVICES.md: what the emulator can verify and what needs the phone.

Verified: MANIFEST and journal hashes recomputed for 1033 and 0508; the
stray signup matched to journal actions by timestamp; F3 from app.log
PIDs before and after the crash.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: CalebK
Message:
qa: audit AUTH-01 rerun on a clean emulator; candidates F5, F6

- reports/AUTH-01-20260926-2221.md: Antigravity's report plus Claude's
  audit section.
- findings.md: F5 (first tap on a form button lost while the keyboard is
  open) and F6 (reopening mid sign-up sends a new code), both candidates.
- task.md: rerun done; BOOK-01 and the qadb report-writing change queued.

Rationale: the rerun was meant to redo 0508 cleanly after the scrambled
typing. It did: no stray accounts. The "17 attempts before a 429" looked
like a broken rate limit but was lost taps, which is an app/plan issue.

Verified: MANIFEST.json (350 files) and journal.sha256 recomputed and
matched; verdicts cross-checked against server.log, mailbox and dbcheck;
throttle rate read from backend/config/settings/base.py.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: TheGyam
Message:
feat(backend): Django API that matches the app, with tests and seed data

Every endpoint the app calls, in the shapes it reads: looks, comments, stylists,
bookings, planner, shelf, library, favourites, uploads, invites, consents and
events. Booking rules, privacy (address only once confirmed, early cancellations
hidden, blocking both ways) and London-time free slots follow the mocks.
seed_db loads the whole mock world from seed.json (npx tsx dump.ts); 76 tests.
